requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, description, and a required receipt attachment

criteria.must: Submitting a claim without an amount is rejected
Submitting a claim without a category is rejected
Submitting a claim without a description is rejected
Submitting a claim without a receipt attachment is rejected
Submitting a claim with all required fields and a receipt succeeds and the claim appears with status pending

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of their own submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee's claims list shows each claim's current status (pending, approved, or rejected)
An employee cannot see claims submitted by other employees

requirements.statement: An employee is notified by email when their claim is approved or rejected

criteria.must: An email is sent to the employee when their claim is approved
An email is sent to the employee when their claim is rejected

requirements.statement: A manager can see expense claims submitted by their team awaiting review

criteria.must: A manager's review queue lists pending claims submitted by their direct reports
A manager cannot see pending claims submitted by employees who do not report to them

requirements.statement: A manager is notified by email when a new claim is submitted to them

criteria.must: An email is sent to the manager when one of their reports submits a new claim

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim, optionally with a comment

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim from a direct report
A manager can reject a pending claim from a direct report with a comment
A manager cannot approve or reject a claim from an employee who is not their report
Approving or rejecting an already-decided claim is rejected

requirements.statement: Finance can see all approved claims that haven't yet been exported

criteria.must: Finance's export queue lists approved claims across the organization that are not yet exported
A claim already marked exported does not appear in the export queue

requirements.statement: Finance can export a batch of approved claims as a downloadable CSV/Excel file

criteria.must: Triggering export for approved unexported claims returns a downloadable CSV/Excel file
The exported file contains the selected claims' details needed for payroll

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so they are not exported twice

criteria.must: After export, the included claims are marked exported
An already-exported claim is not included in a subsequent export batch
